storm.name: MOCHA
storm.attribution: International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS) v04r01, NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. Intensity is USA_WIND, the JTWC one-minute sustained wind. https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/international-best-track-archive

pairing.rule: nearest fix to t + 24 h, accepting a gap up to 6 h

analysis.thresholdSource: operational literature, chosen before the split was computed and not tuned to it
analysis.predictorNote: pre-genesis analysis: the ocean the storm found. Later frames have assimilated Argo profiles taken in the storm's own cold wake.
analysis.caveat: Separation is in the means, not step by step: individual sub-threshold steps do intensify. Read as favourable for intensification, never as a forecast that it will.

qc.note: Track fixes outside the analysed domain carry tchp null and are excluded from the statistics; they are not clamped to the nearest edge cell.

model.attribution: Gridded temperature and salinity from the Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS), dataset incois_argo_10d_VAM: a variational analysis of Argo profiles. Served via INCOIS ERDDAP, https://erddap.incois.gov.in . Underlying profiles are collected and made freely available by the International Argo Program.

qc.note: null cells are land or unanalysed water and must render as absent, not as zero

argo.attribution: Argo data collected and made freely available by the International Argo Program and the national programmes that contribute to it. https://argo.ucsd.edu
